title: ttl<=0 SenML record silently ignored yielding DEFAULT_TTL retention
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/deaddrop.py:167. Sender-provided ttl 0/negative ignored -> 24h default retention, asymmetric with strict past-expires->0 philosophy. Decide policy (reject 4.00 or honor zero) and document.
close_reason: Policy decided: ttl<=0 is honored as immediate expiry (zero retention), consistent with the strict past-expires->0 handling; spec 18.9 defines only 24h default / 7d max, no contrary intent. _extract_ttl now parses ttl without the value>0 skip and clamps to [0, MAX]; add_drop's explicit ttl param no longer overrides <=0 back to DEFAULT. Choice documented in _extract_ttl and add_drop docstrings (file has docstring precedent). Regressions: POST ttl=0 and ttl=-10 yield max_age==0 then 404 on details and empty listings (not DEFAULT); explicit add_drop ttl=0/-10 retain zero. No existing test encoded the old ignore behavior. Full tests/coap: 1679 passed.
